generationRequest.prompt: Use case: edit reference background into ONE isolated transparent FAR ORGAN PARALLAX LAYER for a 2D side-scrolling underwater game inside a dead whale. Preserve reference matte painted gouache style and organ identity. Output landscape16:9 canvas, keep original 1672x941 aspect and composition anchors. This layer contains only 1 or 2 broad perimeter anatomical contours as a single layer, with a large completely transparent center and lower center for gameplay. REMOVE ALL blue water, water rays, bubbles, specks, haze, background wash, floor platforms, near framing, creatures and all props. All empty areas must have genuine zero-alpha transparency, no blue rectangle, no checker pattern. Keep far anatomy muted cool low contrast with soft internal shading but a clean external alpha edge. No bright top ledges that read as gameplay terrain, no cropped gameplay modules. Depict only the following far organ forms: One broad bundle of dead whale longitudinal tail muscle and tendon fibers enters from upper LEFT and runs toward upper middle, plus a very distant shadowy soft boneless fluke silhouette only near far upper RIGHT. Tail flukes contain no skeleton. Muted indigo-burgundy muscle with fine slateblue connective fascia. Absolutely no vertebrae, ribs, bone pores, baleen, teeth, white stone or near floor. Keep entire middle and lower half open transparent; only sparse far organ perimeter forms. The fluke silhouette is attached to distant tendon contour rather than an invented animal. Remove all blue water, glow and haze.
